passages.text: Our class visits a museum with two entrances, and we agree to meet at the one beside the garden. The route note says to turn left after the fountain instead of following the crowd towards the shop. Ben thinks that checking the note is a waste of time because the building is easy to see. However, Mia points out that seeing the building does not tell them which entrance to use. They read the final line together and reach the garden gate before the rest of their group. Ben keeps the note for the return journey, realising that a short check can prevent a long detour.

parallelText.en: Our class visits a museum with two entrances, and we agree to meet at the one beside the garden.
parallelText.zh: 我们班参观有两个入口的博物馆，约定在花园旁的入口集合。

parallelText.en: The route note says to turn left after the fountain instead of following the crowd towards the shop.
parallelText.zh: 路线条说喷泉后左转，而不是跟人群去商店。

parallelText.en: Ben thinks that checking the note is a waste of time because the building is easy to see.
parallelText.zh: 本认为查路线条浪费时间，因为楼很容易看见。

parallelText.en: However, Mia points out that seeing the building does not tell them which entrance to use.
parallelText.zh: 但米娅指出，看得见楼不等于知道用哪个入口。

parallelText.en: They read the final line together and reach the garden gate before the rest of their group.
parallelText.zh: 他们一起读完最后一行，在其他组员之前到达花园门。

parallelText.en: Ben keeps the note for the return journey, realising that a short check can prevent a long detour.
parallelText.zh: 本保留路线条供返程使用，明白简短核对能避免绕远路。

passages.text: At our class picnic, Mia chooses a soft drink without alcohol from the refreshments table. It is plain sparkling water, and she wants to add a slice of orange to it for flavour. Before doing so, she checks that the knife and fruit belong to the shared preparation area. An adult helps cut the orange while Mia puts the used plate in the washing tray. Other pupils choose plain water or fruit juice, and nobody has to copy another person's choice. Keeping the table tidy makes it easier for everyone to prepare a drink they enjoy.

parallelText.en: At our class picnic, Mia chooses a soft drink without alcohol from the refreshments table.
parallelText.zh: 班级野餐时，米娅从饮品桌挑了一杯不含酒精的软饮料。

parallelText.en: It is plain sparkling water, and she wants to add a slice of orange to it for flavour.
parallelText.zh: 这是一杯原味气泡水，她想往里面加一片橙子调味。

parallelText.en: Before doing so, she checks that the knife and fruit belong to the shared preparation area.
parallelText.zh: 动手前，她确认刀和水果属于公共准备区。

parallelText.en: An adult helps cut the orange while Mia puts the used plate in the washing tray.
parallelText.zh: 成人帮忙切橙子，米娅把用过的盘子放进清洗托盘。

parallelText.en: Other pupils choose plain water or fruit juice, and nobody has to copy another person's choice.
parallelText.zh: 其他同学选白水或果汁，谁都不必照别人的选择。

parallelText.en: Keeping the table tidy makes it easier for everyone to prepare a drink they enjoy.
parallelText.zh: 保持桌子整洁，让大家更容易准备自己喜欢的饮品。
